subject: Bridgepoint request: personnel evidence binder & redaction guidance
messages:
From: Liam Hargreaves <liam.hargreaves@bridgepoint.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Bridgepoint Compliance <compliance@bridgepoint.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Hi Priya,

As part of Bridgepoint Financial's SIG intake for Redwood Inference, our compliance group needs a compact evidence bundle covering employee onboarding/offboarding controls, background checks, and security training for staff who have access to customer data. Specifically we are requesting:  

- A roster of hires (last 12 months) with hire date and role (redact PII as needed)
- Background check confirmation (vendor attestations or redacted reports)
- Training completion records for security awareness and data handling (dates + course ids)
- Onboarding & offboarding runbook or checklist showing deprovisioning steps

Can you package these as a single encrypted archive or share a secure transfer link? Our timeline is tight — would you be able to provide an initial package by end of day Friday (2026-11-12)? Also let us know if we should expect any vendor-provided artifacts (e.g., background vendor statements) rather than raw reports.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Hargreaves
Senior Compliance Manager
Bridgepoint Financial

--
Bridgepoint prefers redaction of direct identifiers (SSN, DOB) but request hashed identifiers for internal correlation. If you have a template for redaction we can confirm it meets our audit needs.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Liam Hargreaves <liam.hargreaves@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can get you an initial package by EOD Friday, delivery via a secure Drive folder and an encrypted zip for download. Plan below:  

1) Training roster (CSV): includes employee id (hashed), role, course ids, completion timestamps.
2) Background checks: where permitted we will provide vendor attestations (statement of completion + redacted report snippets). Full raw reports will not be shared; we will include a mapping table with hashed employee ids and vendor confirmation dates.
3) Onboard/offboard runbook (PDF): the operational checklist we use for provisioning and deprovisioning, plus a short appendix showing who owns each step.
4) Example evidence items: sample redacted report (one per vendor) and an export of our training LMS for the last 12 months.

A couple quick clarifications before we finalize:  
- Do you need background checks grouped by role or by hire-date cohorts?  
- Confirm whether Bridgepoint accepts SHA256 hashed employee ids (we'll include salt metadata).

Ben @security: Soojin and I will coordinate redactions and packaging — can you prepare the vendor attestation pulls and the runbook appendix? We'll attach the zip to the Drive share and send a DocuSign link for the transfer confirmation if required.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Compliance Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this reply (we're assembling files).

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Bridgepoint evidence workplan (redaction template + owners)

Ben / Soojin / Grace — looping you in with the inbound ask. Key deliverables and owners:  

- training_roster_october_2026.csv (Priya) — hashed IDs, include course metadata
- background_checks_redacted.zip (Soojin) — vendor attestations + one redacted sample per vendor
- onboard_offboard_runbook_v2.pdf (Ben) — operational owner table included

Soojin: use the redaction template in our compliance folder; apply SHA256 with per-company salt (we'll document the salt separately in the secure notes field). If a vendor will only provide attestations, include the vendor-signed PDF and an index entry mapping hashed IDs to vendor confirmation dates.

Grace: please review the runbook appendix for separation-of-duties statements and escalation contacts. If anything looks like an HR-only artifact and Bridgepoint needs it, we'll add a redaction stub rather than pushing HR-sensitive raw documents.

Quoted below is the external ask for reference. Keep replies terse — we'll upload artifacts to the Drive folder and notify the auditor.

On Nov 7, 2026, at 9:12 AM, Liam Hargreaves <liam.hargreaves@bridgepoint.com> wrote:
> As part of Bridgepoint Financial's SIG intake for Redwood Inference, our compliance group needs a compact evidence bundle covering employee onboarding/offboarding controls, background checks, and security training for staff who have access to customer data...

Priya

--
Internal note: prioritize staff with access to customer infrastructure (SRE, infra, customer-facing eng).

From: Bridgepoint Compliance <compliance@bridgepoint.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Hargreaves <liam.hargreaves@bridgepoint.com>, auditor.team@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: 2026-11-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick confirmation and the workplan. That approach looks good — SHA256 hashed ids are fine and the redaction plan is acceptable. A couple of small asks before you send the package:  

- Please include a manifest.txt in the archive listing filenames and SHA256 checksums.
- If you can, mark which hires are contractor vs full-time in the roster export.
- We prefer the Drive link to be restricted to these emails; alternatively, you can send an encrypted zip to audit@thirdparty-audit.com.

Once we receive the initial bundle we'll confirm whether anything else is needed for SIG mapping.

Best,
Bridgepoint Compliance Team

Attachments referenced: background_checks_redacted.zip (when provided), training_roster_october_2026.csv, onboard_offboard_runbook_v2.pdf
